welle_k3.op.luftschlag.name: Air strikes
welle_k3.op.luftschlag.kurz: drones and jets, one week, no ground taken
welle_k3.op.luftschlag.vorbild: Model: Claw-Sword 2022, one week, 89 targets, one soldier killed, no sanctions.
welle_k3.op.begrenzt.name: Limited ground operation
welle_k3.op.begrenzt.kurz: a zone along the border, about 30 kilometres deep
welle_k3.op.begrenzt.vorbild: Model: Euphrates Shield, Olive Branch and Peace Spring, 2,000 to 4,820 km², 12 to 71 soldiers killed.
welle_k3.op.grossoffensive.name: Major offensive
welle_k3.op.grossoffensive.kurz: the whole target area, deep into the country
welle_k3.op.grossoffensive.vorbild: No precedent since 1974: the deeper the operation, the harder neighbours, the EU and the United States respond.
welle_k3.op.landung.name: Amphibious landing
welle_k3.op.landung.kurz: from the sea onto islands and coasts
welle_k3.op.landung.vorbild: Model: Cyprus 1974, a beachhead in two days, 568 to 1,500 soldiers killed, three and a half years of US arms embargo.
welle_k3.op.sna.kurz: fewer own losses, a higher price abroad: the factions' abuses are blamed on Türkiye
welle_k3.op.grund.abkuehlung: New orders in {tage, plural, one {one day} other {# days}}
welle_k3.op.grund.keine: This operation is not available here
welle_k3.op.schon: This operation is already in force.
welle_k3.op.gewaehlt_sna: Operation against {land}: {form}, with the Syrian National Army.
welle_k3.op.ab_einsatz: Applies once the operation begins. Until then the choice is free.
welle_k3.op.im_krieg: Changing it during the war costs capital and morale.
welle_k3.op.ohne: Without a choice the General Staff fights a mixed campaign, without the turning points of an operation.
welle_k3.op.grenze: The operation has reached its limit. Only a major offensive goes further.
welle_k3.tisch.grund: Front {front}, home support {uhr}, {gefallene, plural, one {one soldier killed} other {# soldiers killed}}.
welle_k3.tisch.kein_wp: No turning point is open. The front moves on.
welle_k3.wz.form_sna: New operation: {form} with the Syrian National Army
welle_k3.wz.welle2_aus: A second wave of strikes begins.
welle_k3.wp.weg: The matter has passed; the war is in another phase.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_stadtkampf.text1: The troops have reached the edge of {stadt}. The General Staff asks whether to storm the city or encircle it.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_stadtkampf.text2: Storming is fast and bloody; soldiers and civilians die in the streets. Encirclement spares lives but costs weeks.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_stadtkampf.warum: Afrin fell in March 2018 after it was encircled; about 137,000 people fled the district. In cities, time and lives weigh against each other.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_stadtkampf.opt.sna: Leave the street fighting to the SNA
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_stadtkampf.satz.sna: Fewer Turkish dead; the images from the city are blamed on Türkiye.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_stadtkampf.aus.eins: The city is encircled; a corridor stays open.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_stadtkampf.aus.sna: SNA factions move into the city.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_stadtkampf.standard: Without orders, the General Staff storms the city.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_flucht.text1: About {zahl} people are fleeing the combat zones. Many head for the Turkish border.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_flucht.text2: If you open the border, they come into the country. If you keep it shut, Europe and the UN are watching.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_flucht.warum: After Peace Spring, OCHA counted about 180,000 displaced in October 2019; after Olive Branch in 2018, about 137,000. Every ground operation drives people ahead of it.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_flucht.opt.aufnehme: Open the border, camps in Türkiye
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_flucht.satz.aufnehm: Half of them come into the country.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_flucht.satz.zone: The army builds camps behind the front and ties down troops.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_flucht.satz.schlies: No camps, no costs, harsh pictures at the border.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_flucht.aus.aufnehme: The border opens; camps go up along it.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_flucht.aus.zone: Tent camps under Turkish protection go up behind the front.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_flucht.standard: Without a decision, the border stays shut.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.titel.U: The Security Council demands a ceasefire
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.text1.U: The Vice President of the United States flies to Ankara. He offers a pause in the fighting with {land|dat}. In return, Washington holds back further sanctions.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.text1.R: The Russian president invites you to Sochi. He offers a pause in the fighting with {land|dat}, with Russian observers on the line.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.text1.U: The UN Security Council unanimously demands an immediate ceasefire with {land|dat} and the withdrawal of foreign troops.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.text2: The pause holds the line where it is. Fighting on now angers the mediator.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.warum: On 17 October 2019 Pence and Erdoğan agreed a 120-hour pause; Sochi followed on 22 October with 150 hours and 30 km. In 1974, Resolution 353 demanded a ceasefire on the day of the landing.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.satz.an: The guns fall silent; Washington holds still.
The guns fall silent; Moscow monitors the line.
The guns fall silent; the world breathes again.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.satz.mo: The pause comes through Moscow; Washington is passed over.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.satz.ab: The operation goes on; the mediator is angry.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.aus.mos: Ankara negotiates in Sochi and accepts the pause there.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.aus.abl: Türkiye refuses; the operation goes on.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_vermittlung.standar: Without an answer, the offer lapses; the operation goes on.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_sanktion.text1.USA: The US Treasury is preparing sanctions on ministries and ministers over the war with {land|dat}. The lira is falling on the markets.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_sanktion.text1.EU: The EU Council backs {land|dat} and threatens Türkiye with sanctions. Several members halt arms exports. The lira is falling on the markets.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_sanktion.text2: Giving way costs speed. Standing firm costs the stock market.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_sanktion.warum: On 14 October 2019 the United States sanctioned two ministries and three ministers. The lira lost 4.3 % and the stock market 7.7 %. After the pause both recovered within two weeks.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_sanktion.satz.einle: The markets calm down; the front moves more slowly.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_sanktion.satz.vermi: A middle way: the threat stays half on the table.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_sanktion.satz.stand: The nation closes ranks; the lira falls.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_sanktion.standard: Without an answer the government stands firm, and the markets pay.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_munition.text1: The General Staff reports only {tage} combat days of ammunition left. In the war with {land|dat}, shells and fuel are running out.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_munition.text2: Buying more costs money; saving costs speed.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_munition.warum: Without ammunition, fighting power collapses. In war the army uses up combat days every month, more at a hard pace.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_munition.satz.spare: No money spent, but the front waits.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_munition.aus.produk: The defence plants ramp up production.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_munition.standard: Without orders, the General Staff rations on its own.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_gefallene.text1: The war with {land|dat} has cost {zahl} Turkish soldiers their lives. The coffins come home; the country mourns.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_gefallene.text2: The nation expects the president to speak.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_gefallene.warum: On 27 February 2020, 33 soldiers died at Balyun in a single day. The counter-strike Spring Shield, a NATO Council session and the Moscow Protocol followed.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_gefallene.opt.nato: Call the NATO Council under Article 4
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_gefallene.satz.verg: As in Spring Shield 2020: drones strike back.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_gefallene.satz.nato: The allies confer, but do not fight alongside.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_gefallene.aus.traue: The country mourns; the government publishes the figures.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_gefallene.aus.nato: The NATO Council meets at Türkiye's request.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_gefallene.standard: The president stays silent. The country asks what for.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.text1.be: Civilians die under Turkish fire near {ort}. {land|anfang} takes the case to the Security Council.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.text1.ve: Factions of the Syrian National Army loot homes near {ort}; people are killed. Videos spread around the world.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.text1.ku: Shells hit UNESCO World Heritage buildings in {ort}.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.text2: The world waits to see whether Ankara investigates or denies.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.warum: In July 2022, eight holidaymakers died near Zakho; Iraq turned to the Security Council. Amnesty and HRW document abuses by allied groups in Afrin. Whoever holds the zone bears the responsibility.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.opt.abzi: Disarm the faction and pull it out
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.opt.schu: Protection zone around the heritage site
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.satz.unt: The world sees accountability; the officers grumble.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.satz.bes: The government sticks to its line.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.satz.abz: The front loses fighters; Türkiye gains standing.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.satz.sch: The heritage site is spared; the front waits.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.aus.abzi: The faction is disarmed and pulled out.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.aus.schu: A protection zone now surrounds the heritage site.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_zivilisten.standard: Without an answer the government denies.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_schlagwelle.titel: The strike wave against {land|akk} is over
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_schlagwelle.text1: Drones and jets have hit their targets in {land|dat}. The General Staff reports the wave as complete.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_schlagwelle.text2: Now you decide: stop, fly another wave or send troops across the border.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_schlagwelle.warum: Claw-Sword lasted one week in November 2022. The threatened ground operation never came.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_schlagwelle.opt.bod: Follow up with a ground operation
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_schlagwelle.satz.bo: The punitive strike becomes a campaign.
The SNA leads, the Turkish army backs it.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_schlagwelle.aus.wel: The General Staff plans a second wave.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_schlagwelle.aus.bod: The SNA crosses the border with Turkish support.
welle_k3.wp.krieg_wp_schlagwelle.standar: Without new orders, the air strikes end.
